deploy-bot: PROD deploy started - tag=v3.6.0-rc2 commit=d2f4e9a env=prod change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. canary=5% -> rolling.
liz: kicking off canary now. monitoring dashboards linked: https://dash.redwood.example/canary/123
raj: watching infra and tailing logs, I'll ping if anything looks off.
ops-bot: smoke checks: cpuload OK, mem OK, grpc health OK
deploy-bot: canary completed at 1749765460 — metrics nominal, shifting to 50% traffic over 5m.
emma: FYI product alerts configured for embeddings latency. I'll watch the new cohort.
raj: seeing a latency bump on embed-service (p50 +120ms, p95 +400ms) starting ~1749765468, correlates with canary traffic shift.
offline note: grafana alert #ALERT-789 fired: EMBED_P95_INCREASE
liz: hold traffic at 50% please. @deploy-bot hold
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused at 50% per hold by @liz. Pinning traffic and tag to v3.6.0-rc2.
joel: can you paste the failing stack traces? any obvious regression in tokenization path?
raj: logs show spike in model-client time, stack snippet:
```
2026-03-18T02:04:28Z embed-client: request id=xyz latency=421ms model=llama-13b
at model-client/serve.go:142
at kvcache/cache.go:87
```
liz: quick triage: is this something we can patch in place or do we roll back to v3.5.9?
emma: impact to customer SLA on embeddings — we should minimize risk. ops preference?
joel: short term rollback safer unless we have a 10-15m mitigation.
liz: decision: rollback to v3.5.9. notify execs and oncall. we'll repro and roll forward with a fix later.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to tag=v3.5.9 commit=a9b1c4f. Starting rollback procedures now.
raj: running rollback command on k8s:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=prev
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service -w
```
ops-bot: rollback job submitted (job id rb-1749765432). watching.
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: embed-service pods replacing (3 -> 3) — health probes passing.
raj: embed p95 back to baseline ~80ms within 4m of rollback start.
emma: customer-facing incident note queued, CC: trustops.
liz: ok closing the cutover. we'll open a postmortem and freeze the v3.6 rollout until root cause verified.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy finished: rollback completed to tag=v3.5.9 at 1749765489. status=rolled_back :white_check_mark:
joel: thanks everyone. action items: repro, fix, e2e test for kvcache interaction, and re-run canary in staging.
liz: I'll create the follow-up ticket and assign owners.
raj: leaving monitoring alerts on for 2h, will escalate if anything else pops up.
ops-bot: deploy window closed. change log updated: https://internal.redwood/changelog/1749765432
deploy-bot: thread auto-archived in 24h. :thumbsup:
